rows.what_the_ink_shows: Above and left of the A in Aut are two isolated surface marks: the upper point has a dark olive/brown centre with a diffuse yellow-brown halo, while the lower trace is a blurred light-grey vertical oval. Their colour and soft edges differ from the sharply black, connected pen strokes of the A, the membership sign, and the superscript plus/minus 1. Neither mark forms a written prime, accent, or other symbol, and neither is connected to the lettering (crops/75_scan012_Q100022_Qsow022_Aut_marks.jpg). The upper point is darker than the earlier model described, but its stained halo and isolated appearance still support a paper/scan speck rather than handwriting.
